messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in us-east-1. Spike started ~2026-03-15T18:05Z. Affected path: batcher/scheduler -> router.
incident-bot: Key metrics: p95 latency 150ms -> 1.1s, p99 > 2.8s, router errors 502/504, batcher queue depth per node up to 6k, HOL signs (one long job holding batches).
rachel: I'm oncall, grabbing console and logs. Paging infra team.
tom: seeing heavy KV cache churn for model rw-gpt-7b-q/v2 on several workers; process_time histograms show new heavy tail. Also seeing repeated `OOM`-ish GC spikes on batcher-3.
kai: are autoscalers healthy? ops-bot, status of batcher autoscale group?
ops-bot: auto-check: group batcher-v3 desired=12 running=9 healthy=6. Pending scaling actions delayed due to AZ imbalance.
rachel: ok. Immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact: 1) enable model circuit-breaker for rw-gpt-7b-q/v2 to fail fast, 2) lower batch wait threshold for impacted pools, 3) evict in-progress long seq jobs. Who can run routing override?
tom: I can push overrides. Suggest route rw-gpt-7b-q/v2 -> rw-gpt-7b-q/v2-slim with forced-cold-start flag.
kai: also add a quick token limit per-request at the gateway: max_seq=1600. That should prevent runaway sequences inflating batch time.
rachel: tom, go ahead with routing override. Kai apply gateway limit. I'll prepare eviction.
tom: running override API: 
```
POST /admin/routing/override
{"match":"model=rw-gpt-7b-q/v2","route_to":"rw-gpt-7b-q/v2-slim","priority":"live-incident","ttl":"10m"}
```
tom: override applied. New request counts to rw-gpt-7b-q/v2 down ~80% in 45s.
kai: gateway rule applied: `max_seq=1600` for route group.
rachel: eviction command (batcher admin): 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/batcher/evict \ 
 -d 'min_proc_ms=1200&target_nodes=batcher-3,batcher-5&reason=HOL_release'
```
rachel: eviction completed: removed ~520 long jobs; batcher queue depth falling.
tom: after eviction p99 proc_time for rw-gpt-7b-q/v2-slim is ~540ms. Overall p99 end-to-end 420ms. Router 5xx rate down 85%.
ai-monitor: suggestion: schedule node replacement for batcher-3 (disk pressure + restart loop). Creating ticket infra#1842.
kai: scaling note: because AZ capacity is limited, spinup in other AZs would be faster; creating request to provision in us-east-1b.
rachel: customer impact: support reports timeouts for customers: dataharbor, ideaworks. Logged incident in Customer Ops.
tom: capturing logs for postmortem: `journalctl -u batcher -o cat --since "10 minutes ago" | gzip > /tmp/batcher-3-incident.log.gz` and uploading to artifacts.
kai: temporary config change: reduce `batch_coalesce_ms` from 100 -> 15 for impacted batch pools. Applied. Immediate improvement in tail latencies.
rachel: monitoring graph shows queue depth fell 6k -> 900 in 2min. No further surge.
ops-bot: created provisioning request req-18456 for replacement nodes in us-east-1b. Estimated 12-20min.
tom: follow-ups to add to postmortem: - detect KV-cache growth pattern via metric `kv_cache_growth_rate` - add auto-circuit-breaker when per-model proc_time p99 > 2s - AZ-aware fallback for autoscaler.
rachel: assigning postmortem owner: rachel. Action owners: kai (gateway guardrails), tom (routing circuit-breaker), ops (autoscale AZ fallback).
jess: quick note: inform top-aggregated customers with short blurb. I'll coordinate comms.
rachel: MITIGATION: confirmed at 2026-03-15T18:19:00Z. All error rates returned to baseline for affected region.
ops-bot: incident log saved to /incidents/2823456789/artifacts.
rachel: thanks everyone — please add any additional notes to the postmortem doc.
